findings.quote: The Complete Story of Noah (Genesis 5-9) KJV
findings.why: The script claims to provide the complete story of Noah, but it only contains a few dislocated KJV verse fragments and unread headings, completely omitting the actual narrative of the building of the ark, the flood itself, the raven and dove, and the rainbow covenant.

findings.quote: Enoch Walked With God The end of all flesh is come before me; for the earth is filled with violence through them. ... The Flood Ends: The Raven, the Dove and the Rainbow Noah did all that God commanded him
findings.why: Section headers from an outline or study Bible were pasted straight into the text without including the actual narrative content described by those headings, indicating low-effort mass-produced template compilation.

narrative_value: Low. The script lacks narrative continuity, consisting of fragmented Scripture verses mixed with raw outline headings rather than a coherent story or teaching.
